g.text: Admin navigates to Employee Management section
System displays list of all employees
System generates unique employee ID & saves new employee to database
System displays employee details in editable form
Admin makes changes & updates employee record in database
Admin enters search term or applies filter
System updates employee status and resignation date
Admin navigates to Attendance Management section
Admin uploads Excel file with attendance data
Updates attendance records for each employee
Admin can view attendance records for all employees
Admin navigates to Leave Management section
System displays all pending leave requests
System sends email notification to employee
System sends email notification to employee
Admin navigates to Salary Calculation section
Calculate base salary, DA, PF, deductions
System displays salary records for all employees
Admin navigates to Holiday Management section
Enter date and description & saves to holiday database
System uses Twilio to send SMS to all employee phone numbers
System displays employee dashboard with personal details
System calculates and displays current experience based on joining date
Employee navigates to Leave Management section
Enter reason, start date, end date
System saves leave request with 'Pending' status
System displays all leave requests with their statuses
System displays current month's salary details
Check current date against holiday database
Marks employees from attendance upload as 'Present'
Checks leave database for approved leaves, marks as 'On Leave'
For 'Absent' employees without approved leave, creates uninformed leave record
Total working days (excluding holidays) & Present days
Calculates base salary, Adds DA, subtracts PF
Applies deductions for uninformed leaves and rejected leave absences
At month end or when initiated by admin?
